source_snapshot.procedure: Collect full SDR list and filtered Sensor List through both IB and OOB ipmitool, then check BMC Web Sensor List.
source_snapshot.criteria: Sensor name, description and reading in SDR, Sensor List and BMC Web match the SPEC.
source_snapshot.deepseek_finding: DeepSeek treats `TEMP_GB_NVS1~4` as one literal sensor, omits IB and Web paths, truncates SDR output and exposes credentials.

original_test_intent.purpose: Verify the TEMP_GB_NVS1 through TEMP_GB_NVS4 sensor family consistently across in-band SDR, out-of-band SDR, in-band sensor list, out-of-band sensor list and the BMC Web Sensor List against the platform specification.
original_test_intent.target: The four named NVS temperature sensor slots for the verified SUT/BMC and actual NV-switch population, not one literal sensor named `TEMP_GB_NVS1~4`.
original_test_intent.scope: Five presentation/path checks for every required/populated NVS1-NVS4 sensor: complete IB/OOB SDR evidence, IB/OOB sensor-list entries and BMC Web information. This is a read-only consistency check, not a thermal stress or threshold-setting test.
original_test_intent.operation: Collect complete timestamped SDR and sensor-list data through both management paths, derive the exact four-name subset without discarding raw evidence, capture Web entries, map each index to hardware population and compare name/description/reading/unit/status with the approved specification and across paths.
original_test_intent.duration_and_iterations: The workbook estimates 3 attended and 3 machine minutes and defines one collection through each required path/interface.
original_test_intent.expected_result: Every sensor required for the installed NVS population is present under the correct index and reports specification-conforming identity, description and readable value consistently across IB, OOB and Web, with no command or UI error.
original_test_intent.required_evidence: SUT/BMC/firmware and NVS population/map; expected per-index fields; complete raw IB/OOB SDR and sensor lists with exit/completion status; derived per-index rows; Web screenshots/export; timestamps; cross-path matrix; missing/unpopulated handling; no-write/no-log-clear audit.
ambiguities: The source does not supply the NVS population/map, exact descriptions or expected readings/ranges.
The tilde notation denotes a family/range but is not a valid guarantee of one literal `sensor get` name.
The required synchronization tolerance between five views is not defined.

v2_review_conclusion.finding: V2 correctly restores the four-sensor family, both IB/OOB command views, BMC Web, complete evidence, secret safety and no-clear rule. It labels the row high-risk/destructive even though the intended test is read-only; only the generic log-clear wrapper is destructive and is explicitly excluded.

applicable_history.decision: V2 corrects the DeepSeek literal sensor/truncated output. No later user ruling supplies the missing per-index SPEC or authorizes log clearing.

v3_review_conclusion.summary: Keep V2's class and complete five-view coverage. Clarify that the core test is low-risk read-only collection; log clearing is forbidden rather than part of the blast radius. Use a per-index comparison matrix so absence, unpopulated slots and cross-view mismatches are not hidden.

available_now: The sensor family, two command types, two command paths and BMC Web interface are explicit.
Complete Actual Values can be collected read-only after target access, even before expected ranges are supplied.
missing_inputs: The BMC/platform owner must supply the installed NVS population, NVS1-NVS4 hardware mapping, exact expected names/descriptions/units/status and acceptable reading rules.
The execution owner must provide approved ipmitool, secret-safe IB/OOB access and an operator or approved browser capture for the Web Sensor List.
execution_readiness_detail.input_owner: The BMC/GPU-baseboard platform owner supplies mapping and SPEC; the lab/automation owner supplies protected command and Web access.
safe_read_only_work_before_closure: Collect complete raw IB/OOB SDR and sensor-list Actual Values and capture the BMC Web entries without clearing logs.
Build a four-index observed matrix and mark missing/unmapped slots without declaring PASS.
prohibited_until_closed: Do not query the tilde expression as a literal sensor, truncate raw SDR output, expose passwords, clear logs, change thresholds, reset BMC, invent unpopulated status or declare correctness without the SPEC.
execution_readiness_detail.closure_verification: Confirm exact platform population/map and expected per-index fields, collect all five views within the approved timing window, and reconcile each NVS1-NVS4 row with raw evidence and documented unpopulated exceptions.

revision_candidate.purpose: Verify each required NVS1-NVS4 temperature sensor's identity and reading across IB/OOB IPMI SDR, IB/OOB sensor list and BMC Web against the platform specification.
revision_candidate.applicable_platform_environment: The exact server/BMC/firmware and NVS population for which TEMP_GB_NVS1 through TEMP_GB_NVS4 are defined, using approved local IPMI, protected RMCP+ and BMC Web access.
revision_candidate.target_scope: Every required or populated NVS1-NVS4 sensor across five source-required views, one collection per view. No threshold write, thermal stimulus or continuous monitoring.
revision_candidate.required_inputs: Verified identities; NVS population/map; expected per-index name/description/unit/status/reading rules; approved ipmitool and IB/OOB endpoints; protected credentials; BMC Web access/capture; timing tolerance; evidence storage.
revision_candidate.test_command_procedure_intent: Capture complete `ipmitool sdr elist` through IB and OOB and complete `ipmitool sensor list` through IB and OOB using secret-safe authentication. Retain raw output, then select exact `TEMP_GB_NVS1` through `TEMP_GB_NVS4` entries individually. Capture the same indices in BMC Web. Build a per-index, per-view comparison against the SPEC without changing BMC state.
revision_candidate.preconditions: Correct SUT/BMC/firmware and population verified; mapping/SPEC available for verdict; tool and paths approved; clocks/context adequate for comparison; credentials protected; no concurrent BMC/thermal update.
revision_candidate.expected_evidence: Identity/version/population/timestamps; expected matrix; complete raw IB/OOB SDR and sensor-list outputs with exit/completion status; per-index derived entries; Web screenshots/export; five-view comparison; missing/unpopulated rationale; no-write/no-clear audit.
revision_candidate.acceptance_reference: The owner-approved TEMP_GB_NVS1-NVS4 sensor definition for the exact platform population plus the source requirement that SDR, Sensor List and BMC Web names, descriptions and readings match it.
revision_candidate.safety_restrictions: Read-only. Do not clear logs, expose credentials, truncate raw evidence, change thresholds or sensor state, reset BMC, treat the tilde string as a literal ID or infer missing hardware population.
revision_candidate.human_approval_requirements: No interactive approval is needed for authorized read-only command collection. The owner supplies the SPEC/population and confirms Web access and platform-specific acceptance.
revision_candidate.manual_boundaries: The agent can collect and compare command data; an operator or approved browser mechanism supplies BMC Web evidence. The platform owner resolves population-specific absence and reading correctness.
revision_candidate.recovery_requirements: No functional recovery is expected. On authentication, command, Web, sensor or mapping mismatch, preserve full evidence and stop interpretation; correct access/context before one bounded recollection.
revision_candidate.stop_conditions: Wrong target/firmware; secret exposure; incomplete/truncated raw output; IB/OOB path mismatch; unavailable Web evidence; missing/unmapped required sensor; stale/invalid reading; unexpected thermal/BMC fault; absent SPEC for verdict; or proposed write/log clear.

identified_defects: DeepSeek queries a sensor-family notation as one literal sensor and omits required paths/interfaces.
DeepSeek truncates SDR evidence and exposes credentials.
The source lacks per-index population, mapping and expected-value rules.
V2 overstates intended-test risk by treating a forbidden generic log clear as the core operation.
reason_for_change: Make the five-view, four-index comparison explicit and keep risk attribution on the forbidden log-clear/credential behaviors rather than the read-only sensor query itself.

new_technical_evidence.title: Source testcase Wistron-BMC-00960-V002
new_technical_evidence.supports: The source explicitly requires SDR and Sensor List through both IB and OOB plus BMC Web and compares sensor name, description and reading to SPEC.
new_technical_evidence.remaining_uncertainty: Population, sensor mapping, values/ranges and timing tolerance are absent.

removed_ambiguities: Expands the tilde notation into four independently accounted indices.
Defines all five required views and preserves raw versus derived evidence.
Separates safe Actual Value collection from final SPEC correctness.
resolved_blockers: Missing expected values do not prevent read-only collection of all current sensor views.
remaining_blockers: Final verdict requires the platform population/map and per-index expected fields/rules; Web evidence needs a human or approved browser capture.
objective_improvement_over_v2: V3 retains V2's correct coverage while making the exact 4-by-5 evidence matrix auditable and correcting the misleading implication that the core read-only query is itself high-risk/destructive.

agent_understanding_result.notes: Isolated validation confirmed the finite TEMP_GB_NVS1-NVS4 scope across five distinct views—local IB SDR, OOB SDR, local sensor list, OOB sensor list and WebUI—with same-BMC identity, signed per-index mapping, unit normalization, capture-window/freshness/tolerance rules, complete raw/UI evidence, allowed-absence rationale, and no PASS from partial views or plausible values.

per_case_integrity_check.source_specific_purpose_fact: Functionality row 1871 requires IB/OOB SDR, IB/OOB Sensor List and BMC Web checks for TEMP_GB_NVS1~4.

per_case_integrity_check.source_specific_safety_evidence_decision: Allow complete secret-safe Actual Value collection across all views; prohibit truncation, writes, log clearing and PASS without the per-index SPEC.
